reviewer: Codex: password account-data, ticket retry and distribution review, 2026-10-15

reviews.reason: The correction restores the already documented account rating and free-ticket display. Balance reads remain authenticated and cannot grant or spend tickets. Failed daily claims can retry only after current consent and verified access, using the existing atomic same-UTC-day idempotent endpoint; reward tiers, limits, make-up policy, prices, billing and data retention do not change. Reauthentication clears stale balance display and older request results are aborted or scoped to the access revision. Release checks reject missing public configuration without recording key material or changing feature opt-ins. Existing Japanese/English hint, contact, privacy and current-terms explanations still apply.
evidence: src/components/LobbyTicketSummary.tsx: refreshes on online, visible/focus and ranked-session change; aborts stale reads and scopes confirmed balances to user ID and access revision. Unknown remains a dash; verified zero remains zero.

src/components/DailyLoginClaimController.tsx: an unsuccessful claim no longer completes the current UTC day. Pending and successful claims remain deduplicated; reconnect retry still requires current consent and circuitAccess.canPlay.

src/components/DailyLoginClaimController.test.ts and related auth/profile/daily-reward tests: 80 passed locally after reproducing the failed-reconnect claim; existing revocation, consent and UTC rollover cases retained.

scripts/qa/check-account-data-browser.mjs: real exported Home, password form, profile client and ticket client, with synthetic transports. Web passed session/persistent reload/zero balances/reauthentication/outage recovery; production writes blocked.

scripts/release/verify-client-config.cjs, build-android-web.cjs and prepare-pages.mjs: fail closed on unresolved public reads and missing configured endpoints/key literals; no secrets are printed. Release-guard checks: 18 passed.

src/locales/siteContent.ts Japanese/English hint/connection/save/privacy FAQs, src/components/SiteInformation.tsx contact entry, src/locales/privacyReview.ts, securityPrivacy.ts, nativeCommercePrivacy.ts and src/config/currentTerms.ts 2026-10-13.1 reviewed.
